purpose: HGSOC case study (GSE211956, 8 Visium sections) run end to end through ChatSpatial MCP tools: QC and preprocessing, RCTD deconvolution with the GSE211956 scRNA-seq reference, copy-number inference with infercnvpy using low-tumor spots as reference, CNV clustering, CNV-cluster marker genes and Moran's I for P3

inputs.visium_source: GEO GSE211956 GSM6506110-GSM6506117 (P1-P8): matrix.mtx.gz, barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, tissue_positions_list.csv, scalefactors_json.json, images
inputs.reference_source: GEO GSE211956 scRNA-seq counts GSM6506105-GSM6506109 with the deposited cell-type labels (8 types), raw counts; labels written with / and spaces replaced by _ (spacexr refuses / in cell-type names), hgsoc157_prep_reference.py

moran.genes: all genes of the section after QC

server_info.name: ChatSpatial
server_info.title: ChatSpatial
server_info.description: Schema-enforced spatial transcriptomics analysis with 20 tools covering 66 methods across 15 analytical categories.
